metadata.name: LazyMattCam
metadata.description:
A silly mod that adds LazyMattMan, who reacts to things that Isaac does, to the game. This mod was made to showcase the capabilities of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3828788794]FaceCam Mod![/url]!
Requires FaceCam Mod and ReactionAPI to function correctly; regardless, your game should be able to run without issue if either mod is not enabled.
